papers.title_en: BiGrounder: Bidirectional Training Unlocks the Potential of GUI Grounding
papers.authors: Dengyao Shi, Tianyu Fu, Fei Hu, Anyang Su, Hanning Wang, Shuo Wang, Minghui Wu, Chenxu Zhao, Zhen Lei
papers.evidence: GUI定位将自然语言指令映射为屏幕坐标，采用双向训练
papers.tldr: GUI grounding需将自然语言指令映射到精确坐标，现有端到端监督仅用少量描述训练，对语言变化鲁棒性不足，强化学习探索也受限。BiGrounder提出双向训练：SFT阶段让模型由坐标生成动作描述，RL阶段在线采样语义一致的指令变体并回定位，用循环一致性门控将语义质量与定位成功耦合。4B模型在五个基准上取得有竞争力准确率。该范式把模型自身指令策略变成持续刷新的强化轨迹来源，释放GUI grounding潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Graphical User Interface (GUI) grounding aims to map natural language instructions to precise operational coordinates, serving as a critical task for autonomous agent interaction. Current approaches formalize GUI grounding as predicting action-coordinate pairs from instructions, with end-to-end training supervised solely by final coordinates. Training datasets typically provide only a small number of descriptions per target coordinate, whereas real-world scenarios involve a much larger set of varied descriptions for the same target, which limits robustness to linguistic variation. While recent GUI grounding paradigms have begun employing reinforcement learning to enhance localization accuracy, models with limited exploratory capability before reinforcement yield constrained improvements even with identical training data during the reinforcement phase. To overcome these limitations, we propose a bidirectional reward paradigm that enables model self-reinforcement. During SFT, bidirectional training equips the model to generate action descriptions from target coordinates. During RL, the model samples semantically consistent instruction variations on-policy and grounds each variation back to its target. A cycle-consistency gate couples semantic quality to grounding success, turning the model's own instruction policy into a source of continually refreshed reinforcement trajectories. Our 4B-parameter model achieves competitive accuracy across five grounding benchmarks in our evaluation, indicating the effectiveness of the proposed training paradigm. https://github.com/Spell-shi/BiGrounder

papers.title_en: Where to Learn and How Far to Roll Out: Efficient Adaptive Training for GUI Agents
papers.authors: Yuxiang Chai, Quyu Kong, Panrong Tong, Steven Hoi, Yue Wang
papers.evidence: 面向多步GUI智能体的自适应强化学习训练框架，含枢轴选择与一步RL
papers.tldr: 轨迹级GRPO训练GUI智能体需反复rollout，已掌握前缀被重跑且任务级奖励难监督中间决策。论文提出两阶段自适应框架：用专家成功轨迹建可复用检查点，以动作分歧选信息枢轴；Stage I在枢轴做一步RL，Stage II按进展扩展Local、Suffix、Root训练。在MobileGym与CUA-Gym-Hub上，交互较Vanilla GRPO减56-61%且表现提升，表明联合分配学习状态与rollout范围可提升GUI智能体RL效率。
papers.abstract_en: Trajectory-level GRPO is a common approach for training multi-step GUI agents, but repeatedly rolling out complete trajectories from the task root can be inefficient: task-level rewards provide coarse supervision over which intermediate decisions require improvement, while already-mastered prefixes are repeatedly re-executed before reaching difficult states. We introduce a two-stage adaptive training framework that jointly addresses where to learn and how far to roll out. We first construct reusable intermediate checkpoints from successful expert trajectories and select informative pivots using action disagreement, which measures uncertainty directly from sampled GUI actions. Stage I performs one-step RL at these pivots to improve uncertain local decisions. Stage II then progressively expands policy responsibility through adaptive Local, Suffix, and Root training according to task progress. Recoverable checkpoints enable repeated training from intermediate states without replaying the preceding trajectory. Across MobileGym and CUA-Gym-Hub, our method reduces environment interaction by 56-61% relative to Vanilla GRPO while improving task performance, demonstrating that jointly allocating training across states and rollout ranges can substantially improve GUI-agent RL efficiency.

papers.title_en: Online Dense Reinforcement Learning with Planning-Grounding Agent for UI Navigation on Live IOS Apps
papers.authors: Peitong Duan, Khashayar Gatmiry, Jeffrey Nichols, Samy Bengio, Emmanuel Abbe
papers.evidence: 在真实iOS应用上训练UI导航智能体的在线强化学习与规划-定位分工
papers.tldr: 现有视觉语言模型UI导航推理成本高，小模型经SFT或离线RL易记忆静态轨迹、缺乏纠错能力。本文提出直接在实时iOS应用上训练的在线强化学习框架，将智能体解耦为规划智能体与UI接地模型，并用LLM-as-a-Judge构建步级密集奖励加终端奖励，结合PPO与GiGPPO优化。实验在多个基准上显著优于SFT和仅终端奖励RL，8B模型跨Android泛化较SFT近七倍提升，并在真实iOS应用上超过Gemini-3.5-Flash、与Gemini-3.1-Pro持平。该工作为低成本、可纠错的实时UI导航智能体提供了可扩展训练范式。
papers.abstract_en: While frontier vision-language models demonstrate strong capabilities in user interface (UI) navigation, their high inference costs prohibit everyday use. Conversely, smaller models trained via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or offline reinforcement learning often memorize static trajectories, leading to brittle execution and an inability to recover from errors. To address these limitations, we propose a novel online reinforcement learning framework that trains UI navigation agents directly on live iOS applications. Our framework decouples the agent into two specialized components: a Planning agent and a UI Grounding model. We rely on an LLM-as-a-Judge to provide comprehensive reward signals, combining dense, step-level feedback to evaluate intermediate progress with a terminal reward for overall task completion. To effectively leverage this dual reward structure, we optimize the agent using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with step-level advantage estimation. Furthermore, we introduce GiGPPO, a novel neighbor-conditioned value estimation method that improves critic stability by leveraging reward signals from visually similar states across concurrent trajectories. To support this online training paradigm at scale, we introduce an efficient infrastructure that orchestrates hundreds of concurrent virtual iOS devices. Evaluations on rigorous benchmarks, including UINavBench, iOSWorld, and AndroidWorld, demonstrate that our online RL trained agents substantially outperform both SFT and terminal-only RL baselines while accelerating training convergence. Notably, our 8B RL agents achieve nearly a sevenfold improvement over the SFT baseline in out-of-distribution generalization to Android environments, while outperforming Gemini-3.5-Flash and tying with Gemini-3.1-Pro on real iOS applications.

papers.title_en: Mage-VL-Cowork: A Full Training Recipe to Learn Hybrid Computer Use From Evolved Harnesses
papers.authors: Xiaoyi Zhang, Haoqing Wang, Xinjie Zhang, Xiang Ming, Xing Wang, Senqiao Yang, Kaichen Zhang, Zhaoyang Jia, Andong Tan, Xinjiang Wang, Jinghao Guo, Yifei Shen, Xiao Li, Peng Zhang, Xun Guo, Jiahao Li, Shicheng Zheng, Jinglu Wang, Zongyu Guo, Wenxuan Xie, Bin Li, Yan Lu
papers.evidence: 在 29 万合成桌面与网页任务上以 SFT 与 RL 训练的混合计算机使用智能体
papers.tldr: 面向需要同时操作图形界面与执行代码/终端的计算机使用代理，Mage-VL-Cowork以4B通用多模态对齐检查点为起点，构建覆盖中训练、SFT与RL的五阶段渐进式课程。配套Mage-CUA-Forge用可复用技能条件生成流程合成29万余桌面与Web任务，并演化教师harness产出高质量轨迹。最终在OSWorld-Verified达到66.0%，以同参数规模SOTA推动端侧智能。
papers.abstract_en: Effective computer-use agents (CUAs) should seamlessly combine visual GUI interaction with code and terminal execution within a single policy. We present Mage-VL-Cowork, a 4B hybrid CUA trained from a general multimodally aligned checkpoint through an end-to-end, progressive five-stage curriculum across midtraining, SFT, and RL. To power this curriculum at scale, Mage-CUA-Forge replaces per-task agent construction with reusable, skill-conditioned generation workflows and application-specific preparers, synthesizing 293,806 desktop and web tasks across 6,915 skills while reducing recurring per-task expenditure by 82.6%. Rather than directly distilling a default teacher, we evolve the teacher harness and instantiate specialized CUA harnesses to yield high-quality trajectories alongside stage-specific supervision. Mage-VL-Cowork-4B finally climbs to 66.0% on OSWorld-Verified through different training stages with more efficient reasoning cost, achieving state-of-the-art performance at its parameter size and pushing forward the frontier of on-device intelligence.

papers.title_en: Hybrid Computer Use: A Unified Programmatic, Semantic, and Visual Interface for General Agents
papers.authors: Haoqing Wang, Xiaoyi Zhang, Sicheng Fan, Zhexin Zhang, Xinjie Zhang, Jiahao Li, Bin Li, Yan Lu
papers.evidence: 面向通用计算机使用智能体的编程、语义与 GUI 视觉统一接口
papers.tldr: 现有计算机使用智能体多以截图和鼠标键盘为中心，强加人类交互先验，需反复解读屏幕，却低估了计算机的语义与程序化能力。为此，作者提出 Hybrid Computer Use（HCU）统一接口，把代码与命令行、无障碍树（AX）、图形界面（GUI）三条通道整合，并配套技能指导智能体选择与组合通道。在 OSWorld 2.0 上，HCU 取得对比系统中最高的 Partial 与 Binary 分数，所有被测模型均有提升，且效率与成功率一致优于基线，说明灵活选择与组合通道的统一接口具有重要价值。
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents increasingly tackle tasks ranging from everyday desktop activities to long-horizon professional workflows. Yet interfaces centered on screenshots and mouse-and-keyboard actions can impose a human-interaction prior, requiring repeated screen interpretation while leaving the computer's semantic and programmatic capabilities underexposed. We argue for exposing these capabilities and letting models choose and combine them. We introduce Hybrid Computer Use (HCU), a unified interface for general agents that combines three complementary channels: programmatic interaction through code and command-line tools, semantic interaction through accessibility (AX), and visual interaction through graphical user interfaces (GUI). Our HCU supports efficient AX interaction and guards against stale-state actions during channel switching. A supplementary HCU skill guides agents in selecting and coordinating channels to use the unified interface effectively. Our designed AX tools return compact observations, execute actions in batches, and report their effects as AX diffs, so the model needs fewer round trips. On OSWorld 2.0, HCU achieves the highest Partial and Binary scores among the compared systems. Analyzing agent trajectories, we find that all evaluated models improve with HCU yet allocate work across the channels differently and consistently outperform compared baselines in terms of both efficiency and task success, highlighting the value of unified computer-use interfaces that allow flexible channel selection and combination.

papers.title_en: MemU-Bench: Benchmarking GUI Agents on Long-Horizon User Interactions
papers.authors: Yizhou Liu, Zhengxi Lu, Fei Tang, Yiwen Qiu, Yong Du, Tongbo Chen, Bofan Chen, Tao Jiang, Wenhao Xu, Yunfeng Shu, Wenqi Zhang, Weiming Lu, Jun Xiao, Yueting Zhuang, Yongliang Shen
papers.evidence: 面向模糊且依赖历史的移动GUI基准，评估智能体记忆能力
papers.tldr: 现有GUI基准多依赖精确、无状态指令，难以评估模糊且依赖历史的真实请求。作者提出MemU-Bench，含118个模糊任务和29条长程轨迹，要求智能体蒸馏交互流并按需检索记忆，以应用数据库验证结果。最佳Gemini-3.1-Pro的SPL仅16.4%，端到端GUI智能体不足5%。为此提出免训练AppMem，用应用中心结构化记忆追踪中断意图并定向检索，使GPT-5.5的SPL从15.7%升至66.9%，为长程GUI记忆评测提供新基准与方案。
papers.abstract_en: Existing Graphical User Interface (GUI) benchmarks predominantly rely on precise and stateless user instructions. In everyday usage, however, instructions are often \emph{vague and history-dependent}: users omit the exact details of their past operations because they no longer remember them, leaving the agent to recover the missing context from long and noisy interaction histories. To bridge this evaluation gap, we introduce \textbf{MemU-Bench}, a mobile benchmark of \textbf{118 vague tasks} grounded in 29 long-horizon user trajectories, where agents must distill raw interaction streams into memory and retrieve the missing context on demand, with task outcomes verified against serialized application databases. Alongside Success Rate, we incorporate Interaction Efficiency (IE) and Success weighted by Path Length (SPL) to expose agents that succeed by exhaustively searching across different applications rather than by \emph{genuinely recalling} the history. Evaluations show that without user history, state-of-the-art systems struggle under such ambiguity: the best-performing Gemini-3.1-Pro achieves an SPL of only 16.4\%, and end-to-end GUI agents fall below 5\%. To address this, we further propose \textbf{AppMem}, a training-free framework that distills user history into a \emph{structured, app-centric} memory bank, tracks interrupted intents across application switches, and selectively retrieves relevant memories via target-app inference. AppMem raises the SPL of GPT-5.5 from 15.7\% to 66.9\% (\textbf{+51.2\%}), outperforms a naive summary baseline by 9.3\%, and delivers consistent gains across evaluated backbones.

papers.title_en: MAPLE: A Multimodal Mobile Agent with Playbook-Learned Experience
papers.authors: Jun Wang, Aurora Wei, Lucas Spangher, Ming Zhang, Eugene Ie, Yiannis Kantaros
papers.evidence: 基于视觉语言模型的移动端GUI智能体，逐步共享经验完成界面导航
papers.tldr: 移动GUI智能体常受限于微调数据与算力开销，或依赖静态启发式与代价高昂的试错探索。MAPLE提出无梯度的多智能体框架，在每一步执行中共享运行时经验并动态演化提示，避免事后反思和盲目循环。在AndroidWorld与MobileWorld上，它在复杂长程移动任务取得SOTA，并展现跨新环境的可扩展与适应性。该工作为移动智能体提供实时经验复用路径。
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous agents powered by vision-language models (VLMs) show great potential in navigating mobile graphical user interfaces (GUIs) to complete complex tasks. However, existing paradigms face fundamental scalability bottlenecks: fine-tuning requires massive high-fidelity datasets or prohibitive training time and compute, while gradient-free approaches rely on custom static heuristics or costly trial-and-error trajectory exploration where feedback is deferred until the end of execution. To address these limitations, we introduce MAPLE (Multimodal Agent with Playbook-Learned Experience), a novel gradient-free multi-agent framework that enables dynamic, step-wise experience sharing and execution-time prompt evolution. Unlike traditional action-reflection architectures that depend on costly, post-hoc self-reflection, MAPLE enables agents to cross-reference and distribute runtime insights in real time at each operational step. This dynamic exchange eliminates blind trial-and-error looping and steers agents along direct, grounded interaction paths. Extensive evaluations on the AndroidWorld and MobileWorld benchmarks demonstrate that MAPLE achieves state-of-the-art performance on complex, long-horizon mobile tasks, while proving scalable and adaptable across novel environments.

papers.title_en: WebHarbor: Docking Real Websites for Evolving GUI Agent Environments
papers.authors: Zhaoyang Wang, Qianhui Wu, Boyu Gou, Demi Wang, Jiacheng Zhang, Peichun Hua, Qize Li, Shi Qiu, Yifan Jiang, Yifan Zhang, Zexu Jin, Baolin Peng, Bolin Shen, Chetan Bansal, Dehan Kong, Deren Lei, Dongshen Peng, Fengqing Jiang, Hao Cheng, Haoqing Wang, Jiaming Shan, Jicheng Wang, Jingguang Zhou, Jixuan He, Kaide Zeng, Kangyu Zhu, Lama Moukheiber, Mufan Qiu, Peng Xia, Qihan Sun, Qingwei Lin, Qiushi Sun, Ruichen Zhang, Shuqing Luo, Si Qin, Sicheng Fan, Tao Xiong, Wenlin Yao, Xinyu Zhang, Xinyue Zeng, Xuanrui Li, Xuchao Zhang, Yian Wang, Yichao Liu, Yiming Liang, Yiyang Zhou, Yizhu Jiao, Yuetai Li, Yurun Chen, Yuxuan Zhang, Zheyuan Yang, Zhiyuan Yao, Zhongyang Li, Zihao Li, Zili Wang, Jianfeng Gao, Huaxiu Yao
papers.evidence: 用于训练与评测GUI网页智能体的容器化真实网站环境
papers.tldr: 真实网站评测受内容变动、访问限制与认证流程覆盖不足困扰，现有合成训练环境又缺功能深度和视觉保真。WebHarbor构建153个可执行、Docker化的网站环境，以任务驱动的人机协作复现真实界面、内容与工作流，并随新任务持续扩展功能范围。它包含3518个多步与登录后任务，可用于稳定评测和低成本强化学习。Qwen 4B级GUI智能体经RL训练后可泛化到未见任务，在四个基准上与领先开源智能体竞争。
papers.abstract_en: GUI web agents require realistic and interactive environments that remain stable during both evaluation and training. Live website evaluation suffers from changing content, access restrictions, and limited coverage of authenticated workflows, while existing synthetic environments for training often lack functional depth and visual fidelity. We propose WebHarbor, a suite of 153 executable and dockerized website environments that faithfully reconstruct the visual interfaces, content, and functional workflows of real-world web services under deterministic control. We build WebHarbor through task-driven human-agent collaboration, where environments evolve as new tasks expand their functional scope, coding agents implement the required changes, and human contributors audit visual fidelity, functional correctness, and task validity. The resulting suite comprises 3,518 tasks spanning multi-step and post-authentication workflows, where existing works often fail to cover. Beyond reliable evaluation, WebHarbor provides high-fidelity synthetic web environments for cost-efficient reinforcement learning (RL). We demonstrate that a Qwen 4B-level GUI agent trained with RL in WebHarbor generalizes to unseen tasks and performs competitively with leading open-source GUI web agents across four benchmarks. The code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/aiming-lab/WebHarbor.

papers.title_en: JHiMA-WebRL: A Joint Hierarchical Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Framework for Long-Horizon Web Tasks
papers.authors: Shanka Subhra Mondal, Jiayun Wang
papers.evidence: 面向GUI网页智能体的分层多智能体强化学习
papers.tldr: 面向长程网页任务的多模态智能体需要高层规划与视觉动作执行协同，单体策略难以兼顾。JHiMA-WebRL 将任务分解器与执行器分层耦合，先用教师模型构建子任务监督并微调，再用分层 rollout 分组和角色特定优势联合扩展 GRPO 优化。在 WebArena-Lite-v2 上，7B 执行器加 7B 分解器平均成功率 37.2%，高于同协议微调的 ScaleCUA-32B 的 24%。消融表明联合更新分解器优于只更新执行器，说明小型模型经角色分解联合学习可竞争单体扩展。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal web agents have shown promising capabilities for interacting with websites through graphical user interfaces (GUIs), yet realistic web tasks often require long-horizon, multi-step planning that remains challenging for monolithic policies. Such agents must jointly infer high-level plans, navigate through intermediate states, track progress over extended interaction histories, and execute visually grounded actions. Although prior work has explored modular multi-agent systems with a separate planner, the planner is typically not updated jointly with the actor. We investigate whether explicitly separating and jointly training planning and execution provides a stronger inductive bias for long-horizon web navigation. We introduce JHiMA-WebRL, a joint hierarchical multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for web agents that couples a task decomposer with an actor. To train the decomposer, we use a strong teacher model to construct structured subtask supervision from multimodal GUI trajectories, and use these annotations to fine-tune both the decomposer and the subtask-conditioned actor. We then extend Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to jointly optimize the decomposer and actor in the interactive WebArena environment through hierarchical rollout grouping and role-specific advantages. On WebArena-Lite-v2, JHiMA-WebRL-14B, consisting of a 7B actor and a 7B decomposer, achieves an average success rate of 37.2%, compared with 24% for a ScaleCUA-32B agent that we fine-tune with RL on the same training tasks and evaluate under the same protocol. Ablations show that jointly updating the decomposer during RL outperforms updating the actor alone. These results suggest that jointly learned role factorization with smaller models can be a competitive alternative to scaling monolithic agents for long-horizon web tasks.

papers.title_en: MKD2World: A Typed Spatial MarkDown World Model For Web Agents
papers.authors: Zhihao Nan, Sifan Zhou, Yiming Cheng, Jinkai Zheng, Zheng Zhu, Si Shi, Ming Li, Fei Yu
papers.evidence: 为GUI智能体联合编码界面布局、语义与位置的类型化空间Markdown状态表示
papers.tldr: GUI智能体需要准确预测动作后界面，但现有状态表示难以同时刻画布局、语义与位置。论文提出类型化空间Markdown（TSM），按空间关系序列化块级与原子级UI元素，并构建AtomBlock-WebUI训练截图到TSM渲染器。基于TSM的两阶段MKD2World世界模型可描述当前状态并预测动作条件下一状态。MKD2World-9B域外EleF1达26.50，超GPT-5.6-Sol的14.98，并将Qwen3.5-35B在Online-Mind2Web成功率从22.94%提至37.61%。
papers.abstract_en: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents can improve decision-making with world-model foresight, provided that predicted states accurately reflect post-action interfaces. Existing state representations fail to jointly capture interface layout, UI semantics, and explicit locations. We introduce Typed Spatial Markdown (TSM), a Markdown-style textual state representation for desktop web interfaces. TSM serializes block-level and atomic-level UI elements according to their spatial relationships, jointly encoding their types, visual semantics, explicit locations, optional control states, and hierarchical membership. To train a screenshot-to-TSM renderer, we construct AtomBlock-WebUI, a dataset with precise annotations at both granularities. By injecting element-type labels into HTML and directly extracting bounding boxes after rendering, we avoid annotation errors caused by post-hoc inference from webpage structures. Building on TSM, we propose MKD2World, a desktop web world model trained in two stages for current-state description and action-conditioned next-state prediction. During inference, the web agent queries MKD2World as needed and performs a ``digest'' step, in which it interprets each predicted state and extracts task-relevant evidence for selecting the best action. Experiments show that MKD2World-9B achieves an EleF1 score of 26.50 on the out-of-domain test set, outperforming GPT-5.6-Sol(14.98) by 11.52 points. Across Online-Mind2Web tasks, MKD2World-9B improves the success rate of the Qwen3.5-35B web agent from 22.94% to 37.61%, achieving competitive performance among leading open-source GUI world models. Code is available at https://github.com/OmniAI-Lab-CUHKSZ/MKD2World.

papers.title_en: DynaRev: Benchmarking Web Agents under Dynamic Goal Revision
papers.authors: Shiqi Zhang, Guochen Zhou, Zesheng Wei, Hai Zhao, Zhisong Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向真实任务的网页智能体基准评测
papers.tldr: 现有Web智能体评测多假定目标预先给定且全程不变，但真实用户会在交互中修改需求。DynaRev构建181个任务的基准，以语义里程碑在任务定义阶段投递修订，涵盖加性修订、无条件覆盖与运行时条件覆盖，并用轨迹评估正确性、响应性和效率。五模型实验表明智能体常只满足部分要求，且表现受任务来源、修订类型和模型影响。该工作为研究智能体适应动态用户目标提供可复现测试床。
papers.abstract_en: Web agents are typically evaluated with goals fully specified before execution and fixed thereafter, whereas real users often revise their requirements during interaction. To study such interactions, we introduce DynaRev, a benchmark of 181 tasks to evaluate web agents under dynamic goal revision. DynaRev uses semantic milestones to deliver revisions at task-defined stages, covers additive revisions, unconditional overrides, and runtime-conditioned overrides, and evaluates correctness, responsiveness, and efficiency through trajectory-grounded evaluation. Five-model evaluations show that agents often satisfy only part of the task requirements, with performance varying across task sources, revision types, and models. Further analyses reveal varied milestone timing, mixed effects of dynamic delivery, and contrasting revision-handling outcomes, with gains from instruction rewriting while preserving browser state and losses from browser resets. DynaRev provides a testbed for studying how web agents adapt to evolving user goals. The code and data are available at https://github.com/zsq259/DynaRev.

papers.title_en: VeriCUA: Verification as Agentic Exploration for Computer-Using Agents
papers.authors: Qiushi Sun, Da Yu, Alexander Knop, Amer Sinha, Lingpeng Kong, Ben Kao, Ravi Kumar, Pritish Kamath
papers.evidence: 面向计算机使用智能体的平台无关任务验证，支撑强化学习与评测
papers.tldr: 跨桌面、移动和网页的计算机使用智能体亟需可靠任务完成验证，但VLM评判受限于给定观察，生成程序依赖可访问状态，易漏关键证据且难跨平台复用。VeriCUA将验证转为智能体式探索：先据上下文构建任务评分细则，再针对未决要求选择GUI或代码检查，并按显式证据规则合并结论。实验显示其与参考标签一致性优于基线，离线难例增益最大，在线更能拒绝虚假完成声明。该工作为多平台在线与离线验证提供统一证据驱动框架。
papers.abstract_en: Building and scaling computer-using agents (CUAs) across desktop, mobile, and web environments requires reliable task-completion verification for data curation, evaluation, and reinforcement learning. Typical automated approaches prompt vision-language models (VLMs) to judge trajectories or generate programs to inspect application state. However, both rely on partial views of complex digital environments. VLM judges are restricted to supplied observations, while generated programs depend on accessible state. These views can omit decisive evidence or leave completion judgments unsupported. Tailoring separate verifiers to different platforms and access settings adds further engineering cost. We present VeriCUA, a platform-agnostic framework for verification through agentic exploration. It treats verification as dynamic evidence gathering and assessment within a shared procedure for online and offline settings across platforms and observation modalities. After inspecting the available context to construct a task rubric, the verifier selects GUI or code checks for unresolved requirements and combines their findings under explicit evidence rules. Experiments show improved agreement with reference labels over the compared baselines across these settings, with the largest offline gains on hard cases and stronger rejection of false completion claims online. Further analyses connect these gains to complementary evidence and test-time exploration.

papers.title_en: UI-UG 2: Advancing Mobile UI Understanding and Generation with Fine-Grained Supervision and Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Hao Yang, Shuoyang Liu, Xiaoyu Lin, Zhou Fang, Maji Huang, Zhaosong Huang, Ruichao Mao, Teng Guo, Hai Rao
papers.evidence: 基于 UI 分类体系与强化学习的移动界面细粒度组件理解
papers.tldr: 移动UI理解与生成既需细粒度组件感知，也需可靠的结构化合成。UI-UG 2以4B多模态大模型统一两项任务，构建80类前端对齐分类体系的多源语料和5000余条需求-截图-JSON数据，并通过DSL与在线GRPO优化生成。实验显示其在80类基准的指代与密集定位领先，4B规模下取得最佳复合生成分数。研究进一步发现细粒度理解监督可迁移至生成，说明组件级语义构成共享表征基础。
papers.abstract_en: Mobile UI understanding and generation require both fine-grained component perception and reliable structured synthesis. Inspired by the unified direction introduced by UI-UG, we present UI-UG 2, a compact 4B-parameter multimodal large language model (MLLM) that advances mobile UI Understanding and Generation with broader task coverage, a front-end-aligned taxonomy, and online render-aware reinforcement learning. UI-UG 2 constructs a multi-source understanding corpus from RICO, VINS, Android in the Wild, and Android Control, annotated with an 80-category two-level UI taxonomy aligned with front-end component semantics, and pairs it with over 5,000 requirement-screenshot-JSON tuples for progressive structured UI generation through a domain-specific language (DSL). For understanding, UI-UG 2 introduces decomposed rewards for category prediction, OCR fidelity, color recognition, dense grounding, and GUI grounding. Unlike the offline Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)-style generation optimization in UI-UG, UI-UG 2 optimizes generation through end-to-end online Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO): sampled DSL outputs are rendered with a Playwright-based server-side pipeline and evaluated using LLM-as-a-Judge and contrastive preference ranking. Experiments show that UI-UG 2 achieves the strongest referring and dense-grounding results among the evaluated models on our 80-category benchmark, and achieves the best composite generation score among compared models at a compact scale (4B). More importantly, we observe a consistent understanding-to-generation transfer: adding fine-grained UI perception supervision improves generation quality under a fixed training budget, suggesting that component-level semantics provide a shared representational foundation for both tasks.

papers.title_en: Coati: Host-Grounded Execution for Installable Mobile GUI Agents
papers.authors: Yudou Ying, Pu Shi, Hanlei Shi, Yuhua Zheng
papers.evidence: 可安装于手机本机、带动作核验的移动GUI智能体
papers.tldr: 现有移动GUI智能体多依赖电脑经ADB远程操控手机，普通用户难以安装使用，且模型难以核实动作结果。Coati作为可安装Android应用，在手机宿主记录动作效果与跨应用结果，用VerifyLoop审计完成声明、AppMemory复用应用流程，并路由快执行器处理简单步骤。116个AndroidWorld任务三次试验成功率达86.5%，超过Artemis的77.6%，同时减少虚假完成并显著提速。这表明宿主证据而非模型自评，能让手机智能体可靠、快速且易用。
papers.abstract_en: Mobile GUI agents can carry out tasks across apps, yet most run on a separate computer that drives a phone over the Android Debug Bridge (ADB), out of reach of ordinary users and of the apps through which most people reach Web services. We present Coati, a source-available agent that users install as an Android app. Its runtime on the phone, the host, records what a model alone cannot see: the effect of each action at its target, result screens across apps, and the progress of repeated steps. VerifyLoop checks action outcomes and completion claims against host evidence and reports a completion it cannot audit as unverified. AppMemory builds per-app procedural memory from observations that the interface supports and reuses it on later visits. A routed fast executor lets a lightweight selection model take simple, confident steps and lets the host repeat loops of simple steps that the large model plans once. On all 116 AndroidWorld tasks, with Gemini 3.8 Flash as every agent's backbone, Coati succeeds on 86.5% of the tasks over three trials, ahead of the strongest open-source agent Artemis (77.6% with the same accessibility-only access, 76.5% even when allowed ADB) and far ahead of FinalRun and Midscene (about 59%), and VerifyLoop cuts false completion claims by about a third at comparable success. In everyday use, the fast executor cuts the median time of phone tasks by 39% at comparable success and runs three of four loop tasks 2.8-5.4x faster with 6-9x fewer model tokens, while AppMemory shortens a repeated deep route in an unfamiliar app from 18.5 steps to 6-7. On an Android 16 phone, routed execution completes all 27 benchmark runs with 76% fewer Reasoning calls on the critical path. Host evidence, not model self-assessment, makes an installable agent reliable and fast.

papers.title_en: TaskFrame: Connecting Task-Level Planning with Frame-Level Control for Game Agents
papers.authors: Guangzhi Wang, Junfu Pu, Yiran Wang, Xingyilang Yin, Honghao Chen, Cheng Cheng, Lingen Li, Yinan Zhou, Jiarui Wu, Yinuo Jiang, Hongbo Jin, Xiaodong Cun, Ying Shan
papers.evidence: 视觉语言规划器配合帧级键盘鼠标控制
papers.tldr: 通用游戏智能体需同时具备高层任务推理与低延迟帧级操控，但单一模型难以兼顾两类计算特性。TaskFrame 提出分层规划器-控制器框架，用视觉语言规划器将目标分解为原子指令，并通过特殊目标 token 的隐藏状态缓存目标嵌入。因果 Transformer 控制器结合当前目标嵌入与近期观测，逐步输出键鼠离散动作和连续视角移动。Minecraft 实验显示其指令分解具竞争力，闭环战斗成功率优于对比基线，为任务规划到帧级控制提供可行连接。
papers.abstract_en: Building general game agents requires both high-level task reasoning and low-latency action control in rapidly changing visual environments. These capabilities favor models with substantially different computational profiles, making them difficult to realize within a single model. In this work, we present TaskFrame, a hierarchical planner-controller framework that connects task-level planning with frame-level keyboard-and-mouse control. A vision-language task planner decomposes a high-level goal into an ordered sequence of atomic instructions and is optimized through supervised learning and dependency-aware GRPO. The hidden states of special goal tokens that terminate each atomic instruction provide continuous goal embeddings that are cached and reused across control steps. A causal Transformer controller combines the embedding of the active goal with recent observations to predict discrete keyboard and mouse-button actions and continuous camera motion at every game step. We train the system in three stages: planner training, controller pretraining, and joint alignment. Experiments in Minecraft show that TaskFrame is competitive with general-purpose vision-language models on instruction decomposition, and that in closed-loop evaluation the agent achieves a higher combat success rate than the evaluated baselines.

papers.title_en: Interface Quilt: Modifying Applications with Computer Use Agents and Generative UI
papers.authors: Leping Qiu, Jo Vermeulen, Tim Zindulka, George Fitzmaurice, Fraser Anderson
papers.evidence: 计算机使用智能体操作现有界面并结合生成式UI
papers.tldr: 当现有应用不提供程序化修改接口时，直接定制或扩展其功能通常很困难，现有方法也依赖源码或接口。论文将计算机使用代理与生成式UI结合，提出“接口补丁”的设计空间和实现框架，并构建 Interface Quilt 系统。该系统在原有应用之上生成新的覆盖界面，无需源代码、API或无障碍数据，即可改变应用的呈现、交互和能力。跨多种应用的演示验证了其可行性，为无侵入式软件修改提供了新路径。
papers.abstract_en: Modifying an existing application is difficult when it does not provide programmatic access for that change. Recent advances in computer-use agents (CUAs) enable richer understanding and operation of existing interfaces, while generative UI (GenUI) makes it practical to generate new ones. We examine how these advances expand software modification through a design space of what can be changed and a framework for how modifications can be implemented. We then introduce Interface Quilt, a system that combines CUAs and GenUI to generate interface patches, which are new interfaces displayed over an existing application to modify its presentation, interaction, and capabilities. Through demonstrations across a variety of applications, we show that interface patches support a range of modifications without source code, APIs, or accessibility data.

papers.title_en: MAGAR: Multimodal Agents for GUI-Based 3D Mechanical Assembly and Minimal Rework
papers.authors: Jingxuan Wei, Jiahao Fu, Fuqiang Wang, Xiaoming Wu, Yuwen Liu, Kaiwen Wei, Ming Yang, Junnan Zhu
papers.evidence: 面向 GUI 多模态智能体的 MAGAR-Bench 基准与装配纠错指标
papers.tldr: GUI命令在界面层正确仍可能导致错误装配，智能体需识别部件、结构关系与返工范围。为此作者提出MAGAR-Bench基准，含26个装配族4000个多模态样本，并拆分装配决策、原子动作与最小返工；同时提出选择性纠正框架MAGAR，将纠正粒度匹配输出依赖，并用学习选择器按任务阈值决定是否采纳候选。在留出装配族上总体分从37.50升至41.39，三类任务均提升；209次干预中70次纠正错误、22次引入错误。结果支持任务特定纠正，同时揭示修复错误与保留可靠预测之间的权衡。
papers.abstract_en: A GUI command can be correct at the interface level yet still produce an incorrect assembly. An agent must identify the relevant components, respect their structural relationships, and determine which parts should move during recovery. We introduce MAGAR-Bench, a benchmark of 4,000 multimodal samples from 26 assembly families that separates Assembly Decision, Atomic Action, and Minimal Rework. For rework, the objective counts distinct moved parts within the validated recovery candidate set for each state, rather than the number of actions. We also introduce MAGAR, a selective correction framework built on a frozen policy obtained by supervised fine-tuning. Its key design matches correction granularity to output dependencies. Structured candidates revise assembly fields and rework scope, while complete action candidates keep native GUI primitives coupled with their parameters. A learned selector retains the original prediction unless a candidate passes a task-specific intervention threshold. On recorded states from held-out assembly families, MAGAR improves Overall, the task-balanced aggregate, from 37.50 to 41.39, with gains on all three tasks. Across 209 interventions, 70 correct an error and 22 introduce one. These results support task-specific correction while highlighting the remaining tradeoff between fixing errors and preserving reliable predictions.

papers.title_en: ScienceCUA: Resource-to-Skill Construction and Execution-Guided Skill Evolution for Scientific Computer Use Agents
papers.authors: Daiqiang Li, Jingyi Peng, Rui Hu, Jia Li, Xuyang Liu, Guanren Qiao, Yujia Xiang, Qiuzhuang Sun, Zhiping Xu, Mingrui Luo
papers.evidence: 面向科学软件操作的计算机使用智能体，从文档构建可复用技能
papers.tldr: 科学软件代理需要应用专属知识，但文档与部署版本、任务范围存在错配，难以直接转为可执行技能。ScienceCUA采用两阶段框架：先从文档识别任务并泛化为可复用Skills，将命令、语法和快捷键整理为References；再用执行反馈对比成功与失败轨迹，修订或新增技能并经验证后更新技能库。实验表明初始技能与参考带来最高7.23个百分点提升，技能自进化使总增益达17.12个百分点。该工作将软件文档转化为可进化技能与可查询参考，助力通用代理可靠使用科学软件。
papers.abstract_en: Computer-use agents for scientific software require application-specific expertise. Much of this expertise is documented in human-authored software manuals and web pages. However, turning these resources into executable, reusable skills remains challenging due to mismatches between documented and deployed software versions and differences in scope between documentation coverage and task requirements. We introduce ScienceCUA, a two-stage framework combining resource-to-skill construction with execution-guided skill evolution. First, ScienceCUA identifies tasks supported by the software from its documentation, infers operational trajectories, and generalizes them into reusable Skills. Command catalogs, syntax constraints, and shortcuts are organized separately as References for on-demand lookup. Then, ScienceCUA uses execution feedback to drive skill self-evolution by contrasting successful and failed trajectories for the same task, identifying deficiencies, revising existing skills or adding new ones, and updating the skill library only after repeated validation in real environments. To enable reliable evaluation without benchmark noise or task leakage, we introduce two improved benchmarks. ScienceBoard-Verified provides an audited and corrected basis for measuring task performance, while ScienceBoard-VE separates skill evolution from final testing through disjoint evolution and test tasks and further supports native-agent evaluation. Experiments show that the initial Skills and References improve average task success rate by up to 7.23 percentage points over the base model, while skill self-evolution increases the total gain over the baseline to as much as 17.12 percentage points. ScienceCUA turns software documentation into an evolving set of executable skills and queryable references, offering a practical way for general-purpose agents to use scientific software reliably and at scale.

papers.title_en: ANGLER: Verifier-Grounded Benchmarking with an Adaptive Attacker for Web Agents
papers.authors: Yini Huang, Aiwen LU, Zhen Sun, Yi Han, Yuzhi Zhao, Jiaheng Wei
papers.evidence: 面向网页智能体的可执行网站红队评测基准
papers.tldr: Web智能体易受网页注入内容诱导执行未授权操作，现有评测多用固定攻击或单类型攻击，且只在文本层面判断，低估真实风险。为此，作者提出带状态验证器的可执行红队基准REEF，并构建由近失结果引导变异与筛选的自适应攻击框架ANGLER。在8个VLM智能体上，ANGLER端到端攻击成功率达20.36%，高于非自适应15.24%，并将良性任务成功率从61.9%降至44.4%。该工作以真实状态变化验证攻击效果，为Web智能体安全评测提供更可信、可迭代的红队方法。
papers.abstract_en: Web agents are increasingly deployed to complete tasks autonomously on real websites, where adversarially injected content can induce them to perform unauthorized actions. Existing evaluations primarily use fixed attacks or focus on a single attack type, and evaluate attacks at the text level rather than through real state changes, thus underestimating how vulnerable agents are to diverse attacks. To address the gap, we introduce REEF, a benchmark of red-teaming executable environments with faithful verification for measuring the security vulnerabilities of web agents. REEF covers 9 verifier-grounded websites spanning travel, commerce, productivity, media, and communication, and pairs every authentic benign task with a malicious objective delivered through 5 attack types at both the user and the environment level. REEF's state-based verifiers provide the execution feedback that drives ANGLER, an adaptive near-miss-guided lure evolution framework for red-teaming. Rather than evaluating a fixed attack set, ANGLER uses outcomes from prior rollouts to guide LLM-based attack mutation and candidate selection, prioritizing near-miss seeds during refinement. Across 8 VLM-based web agents, ANGLER achieves an end-to-end attack success rate (ASR) of 20.36%, compared with 15.24% for the non-adaptive setting. Compared with attack-free execution on the same benign tasks, attacks generated by ANGLER reduce benign task success rate (BSR) from 61.9% to 44.4%.

papers.title_en: Can LLM Agents Learn to Test? Maintaining Scoped Experience as Testing Evidence for Mobile GUI Testing
papers.authors: Zimu Liu, Xiaoxi Guo, Xiaolu Tang, Liang Yu
papers.evidence: 维护受控可复用经验的LLM移动GUI测试智能体
papers.tldr: 移动GUI测试可复用历史路线与定位器，但旧经验在新应用或版本中可能失效甚至误导。论文提出AdaptiTest的维护契约，为可复用经验设定适用范围、来源溯源及确认、复验、撤回生命周期，并由Reflector角色负责持久化。六任务三重复子集上，有记忆完成18/18次运行，无记忆仅3/18；但单智能体对照也能解决早期困难任务。研究强调这是有边界的设计与案例研究，未证明普遍有效性或优于独立GUI智能体。
papers.abstract_en: Repeated mobile GUI tests can reuse routes, locators, and recovery strategies from earlier executions. However, a route that worked in one workflow or app version may be irrelevant or misleading in another. We study how an LLM-based tester can retain useful experience while withholding entries contradicted by current observations. We present a maintenance contract for AdaptiTest in which reusable experience has an explicit applicability scope, trace provenance, and a lifecycle for confirmation, revalidation, and withdrawal. The contract reserves persistence for a Reflector role and treats recalled experience as advice. The archived implementation does not establish end-to-end enforcement of every specified mechanism. The design changes retrieved context, not model weights. The evaluation uses read-only Android workflows and archived internal comparisons. A six-task, three-repeat ready subset reports 18/18 completed runs with memory versus 3/18 without it, but a grounded single-agent control also solves the earlier hard-task slice. A separate cross-session probe is excluded from efficacy conclusions because of confounded route schedules and unvalidated state labels. We examine 13 selected real-update hazard records across nine subjects, distinguishing stale-locator observations from policy-based withholding and offline retrieval diagnostics. The latter do not measure live-device failures or actions saved. These events are UI changes, not confirmed regression bugs. The evidence supports a bounded design and case study; it does not establish general efficacy, superiority over independent GUI-agent systems, or unrestricted exploration.

papers.title_en: A Multi-Modal Robotic Framework for Physical GUI Interaction Testing
papers.authors: Davi Freitas
papers.evidence: 通过外部感知手机GUI状态并执行物理触控的非侵入式机器人框架
papers.tldr: 移动应用自动化测试在真实设备上难以非侵入地复现用户交互并验证GUI行为，现有DLD/R-DLD虽能检测活动重启导致的数据丢失，但仍依赖系统级访问。为此，博士研究提出RFNIT多模态机器人框架，通过外部相机与OCR感知界面状态，由LLM推理代理决策并驱动机器人执行触摸、滑动和打字。初步实现按钮、文本框和虚拟键盘识别，视觉检测准确率超过85%，并保持类人操作与可重复性。该工作为真实设备GUI测试提供端到端、非侵入且可复现的自动化方案。
papers.abstract_en: Automated testing of mobile applications remains challenging when realistic user interactions must be reproduced and GUI behavior verified without relying on invasive mechanisms such as instrumentation or ADB-level control. Existing approaches, including DLD and R-DLD, detect data loss triggered by activity restarts but still depend on system-level access, which limits their applicability on real devices.   This doctoral research proposes RFNIT, a multi-modal, fully non-invasive robotic framework for physical GUI interaction testing on smartphones. RFNIT supports end-to-end automation by perceiving the device state through external sensing and executing physical interactions, enabling human-like actions while preserving reproducibility and execution accuracy.   The framework integrates a vision-based perception module, an LLM-driven reasoning agent, and a robotic actuator capable of performing touch, swipe, and typing gestures. Multimodal data, including external camera images and OCR-extracted text, are combined to identify GUI elements and guide subsequent testing decisions.   Preliminary results indicate that RFNIT accurately recognizes buttons, text fields, and virtual keyboards from external camera input, achieving over 85\% visual detection accuracy. Ongoing and future work will focus on improving robustness, repeatability, and coverage of GUI states during long-running testing sessions.
